title: helichrysum italicum subsp. serotinum
intro: Helichrysum italicum subsp. serotinum, commonly known as the Cretan Everlasting or Italian Stripped Everlasting, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family, known for its ability to retain its flowers and foliage long after it has died. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum italicum subsp. serotinum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied extensively for their potential health benefits.
